scenarios.scenarioName: REQ-1.3.1 - Import CSV to Create a Workbook - Scenario 1
given:
The visitor is on the workbook home page and has a CSV containing quoted commas, a quoted newline and quote escapes, UTF-8 English and Chinese text, numeric text including 007, and blank fields.
The input file uses UTF-8 (text/csv) and a runtime-unique workbook name followed by .csv. Its exact content in JSON string notation is "Name,Note,Count,Blank
Alex,"Harbor District, East",42,
Jordan,"They said""hello""
next line",3,
Alice,English text 中文,007,". In this notation, 
 denotes CRLF and 
 denotes LF; quoted CSV fields retain embedded line breaks.
when: The user opens Import CSV, uploads the CSV, and confirms the import.
then: The uploaded file opens as a workbook on Sheet1. A1:D1 contains Name, Note, Count, Blank in that order. A2 is Alex; B2 is the single field Harbor District, East; C2 is 42 and D2 is empty. A3 is Jordan; B3 contains They said"hello" followed by the supplied line break and next line; C3 is 3 and D3 is empty. A4 is Alice, B4 is English text 中文, C4 is the ordinary text 007 and D4 is empty. Every decoded cell remains at its original coordinate after refresh.
scenarios.reviewBasis: R2 targeted source-to-assertion review
scenarios.coverageBoundary: Finite scenario evidence; descriptive combinations and all legal UI variants are not exhaustively measured.

scenarios.scenarioName: Refuse a final-cell validation failure without consuming undo
given: A1:B2 contains 10, 20, =A1+B1, 120 in row order; D1:E2 contains 1, 2, 3, 4. G1 is =A2+D2 and H1 is =G1+E2. Apply a 0–100 numeric rule to E2, then enter History marker in H2 as a separate edit.
when: Cut A1:B2 and paste at D1. Inspect the validation error and worksheet, click Undo once, repeat the rejected cut, then Redo once and reload.
then: The 120 in the final destination cell causes rejection. All eight source/target cells, both downstream formulas and their results (33 and 37), and the marker initially remain unchanged. Undo removes only the marker. The second failed cut leaves the marker blank and preserves the redo entry; Redo restores only the marker. After reload the same values and formulas remain, and E2 still rejects 101.
scenarios.reviewBasis: Transaction-guard review plus current source/callback mapping
scenarios.coverageBoundary: Finite scenario evidence; descriptive combinations and all legal UI variants are not exhaustively measured.

scenarios.scenarioName: Undo and redo a validated move with chained external dependencies
given: A1:B2 contains 10, 20, =A1+B1, 60 in row order; D1:E2 contains 1, 2, 3, 4. G1 is =A2+D2 and H1 is =G1+E2. H2 is blank and E2 has an inclusive 0–100 numeric rule.
when: Cut A1:B2 and paste at D1. Undo once, Redo once, then reload.
then: A1:B2 becomes blank and D1:E2 becomes 10, 20, =D1+E1, 60. G1 becomes =D2+D2 with result 60; H1 retains =G1+E2 and becomes 120. Undo restores the complete pre-move worksheet including G1=33 and H1=37; Redo and reload retain the complete moved state. The 0–100 validation at E2 remains enforced.
scenarios.reviewBasis: Transaction-guard review plus current source/callback mapping

scenarios.scenarioName: Validate an overlapping move against its calculated final values
given: A1=4, B1=7, A2 is =A1+$E$1, B2 is =A2+$B$1, C1=90, C2=9 and E1=10. F1 is =A2+B2+C1 and G1 is =F1*2. C2 has an inclusive numeric range 0–20. Moving A1:B2 to B1 would yield 21 in C2.
when: Cut A1:B2 and paste at B1; inspect the refusal. Then change A1 to 2, cut the same range again and paste at B1. Undo once, Redo once and reload. Try entering 21 directly in C2.
then: The failed paste keeps all original raw values, formulas and results. The retry succeeds with results B2=12, C2=19, F1=38 and G1=76 and the same rewritten formulas as the valid overlap. Undo restores the pre-retry worksheet (A1=2, F1=121, G1=242), not the original A1=4. Redo and reload keep the complete moved state. C2 still rejects 21; its saved formula and all dependent results remain intact.
scenarios.reviewBasis: Transaction-guard review plus current source/callback mapping
